Cell.Data: <Stim1> Carlos broke the rules of the buffet and packed food for his roommate. </Stim1>
<Stim2> Evelyn asked her sister for a sip of her cocktail but then drank the entire thing. </Stim2>
<Stim3> At the fast-food store, Leo got a free cup for water but filled it up with soda. </Stim3>
<Stim4> Martha riding a bike, approached a car and said to the driver, "You are ugly," and rode off. </Stim4>
<Stim5> Todd lied on his resume, claiming to have received a Master's degree from Stanford. </Stim5>
<Stim6> Betty cheated on her boyfriend with his roommate. </Stim6>
<Stim7> At the soccer game, Nathan knocked out another parent who ridiculed his son. </Stim7>
<Stim8> Albert got fired and, in response, entered the personnel manager's office and severely beat him. </Stim8>
<Stim9> Tara, a restaurant owner, put a mild poison into a competing restaurant's beef delivery, making over 50 people sick. </Stim9>
<Stim10> Paul, the yearbook editor, lost the corrections his assistant had made, and several names were printed incorrectly. </Stim10>
<Stim11> When greeting them, Jasmin addressed her male co-worker's wife as his mother. </Stim11>
<Stim12> Preoccupied with end-of-year work, Amy missed her dad's birthday. </Stim12>
<Stim13> New employee Marcus, not knowing the US laws, sold cigarettes to a 16-year-old. </Stim13>
<Stim14> Joshua was texting while walking on the sidewalk and knocked over a toddler. </Stim14>
<Stim15> Ruby, a police officer, put up a blockade that later obstructed an ambulance's route to the hospital. </Stim15>
<Stim16> Glenn dozed off for a second while driving and hit an old man crossing the street. </Stim16>
<Stim17> Claire’s one-year-old son passed out and slipped into a coma after Claire left him in the car to go grocery shopping. </Stim17>
<Stim18> Smoking in the boiler room, Kimberly carelessly dropped the smoldering cigarette and caused a gas explosion that killed a first-floor resident. </Stim18>
